_note: Shared transform applied to every depthproj clip so the point cloud is upright and on the stage. The depthproj world frame is the reference sensor's CAMERA frame (x right, y DOWN, z forward toward the subject), so a 180-degree rotation about X stands it up and faces it toward the viewer. The rig is fixed, so one transform serves all clips. TUNE position/scale by eye in `npm run dev`; rotationEuler is in degrees.
